column1: # Nexus level thresholds (cores per level) from the `level` field of every Fandom page in Category:Nexus, which the BS01-BS77
# export drops. Read 2026-10-18 through the wiki API in the owner's built-in browser (1,375 pages).
# Key = first 6 hex digits of SHA-1 of the page title (UTF-8), so the file stays small; tools/import_fandom.py hashes the title
# from each card's `source` URL. Value = cores needed for each level in page order (levels 1, 2, ...), comma-separated.
# Two pages list a single level that is not LV1 (e.g. "Level 2: 1 core"); their value has one number and the importer keeps
# the card's own data when the text needs more levels.
